shellCommands.command: ls -la && git show --stat HEAD && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -c 600 package-lock.json; node --version

export BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3999; rm -rf /tmp/smoke
node server.js & P=$!; sleep 0.5
L=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' -d 'title=Middlemarch&author=George Eliot&notes=Dorothea!' localhost:3999/books); echo "redirect: $L"
curl -s -d 'title=Piranesi&author=Susanna Clarke' -o /dev/null localhost:3999/books
curl -s -o /dev/null -d next=/ "$L/finish"
kill $P; sleep 0.3; cat /tmp/smoke/books.json
node server.js & P=$!; sleep 0.5
curl -s localhost:3999/ | sed -n '/<h2>Currently/,/Add a book/p'
curl -s "$L" | sed -n '/<h2>/,/All books/p'
kill $P; rm -rf /tmp/smoke
